dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Boss Nef'll be okay, right? I know she wanted me to stay at my post, but...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Screw it! I'll knock off early and go see how she is.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If she's still not feeling well, I might have to go ask Lauma to have a look at her...
